optimized_sql:
WITH customer_total_return AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        wr.wr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        ret_addr.ca_state AS ctr_state,
        SUM(wr.wr_return_amt) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM web_returns AS wr
    INNER JOIN date_dim AS dd ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    INNER JOIN customer_address AS ret_addr ON wr.wr_returning_addr_sk = ret_addr.ca_address_sk
    WHERE dd.d_year = 2000
    GROUP BY wr.wr_returning_customer_sk, ret_addr.ca_state
)
SELECT
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_salutation,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
    c.c_birth_day,
    c.c_birth_month,
    c.c_birth_year,
    c.c_birth_country,
    c.c_login,
    c.c_email_address,
    c.c_last_review_date_sk,
    ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
        ctr2.ctr_state,
        AVG(ctr2.ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS avg_total_return
    FROM customer_total_return AS ctr2
    GROUP BY ctr2.ctr_state
) AS state_avg ON ctr1.ctr_state = state_avg.ctr_state
INNER JOIN customer AS c ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
INNER JOIN customer_address AS cur_addr ON cur_addr.ca_address_sk = c.c_current_addr_sk
WHERE ctr1.ctr_total_return > state_avg.avg_total_return
  AND cur_addr.ca_state = 'AR'
ORDER BY
    c.c_customer_id,
    c.c_salutation,
    c.c_first_name,
    c.c_last_name,
    c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
    c.c_birth_day,
    c.c_birth_month,
    c.c_birth_year,
    c.c_birth_country,
    c.c_login,
    c.c_email_address,
    c.c_last_review_date_sk,
    ctr1.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
